text: hey, got a snap from the cam over the pressure transmitter on the pipeline manifold, can you box out wherever there's gear or people in the frame? btw none of these pics are allowed off the refinery grounds, and plain-jane accuracy is totally fine for this one.

yo, snapped the engine room gauge panel on the ship, can u pull the readings off the pic for me? gotta be spot-on tho, like the best accuracy you've got, but no rush at all, whenever it comes round in the queue is cool.

Okay so, for the SLA bit: the provider shall take the dash-cam frames from our school buses and mark every kid, car and bike with a box showing where it sits in the shot. Results gotta be the most accurate you can manage, no cutting corners. And these jobs jump the line, they get handled before anything else in the pile.
Heads up! The particle counter in the cleanroom just posted a photo of its display, pls grab the digits off it. A regular-grade read is plenty here, nothing fancy needed.
Hey assistant, take the latest shot of the ferry gangway and put boxes around every passenger and bag on it, okay? Make it super accurate, top tier, but eh, it can wait its turn, nothing's on fire.

Hi Marco, so the camera looking at the fermenter hatch caught some stuff floating around up top, and I'd love it if you could run the image and draw boxes around each bit of gunk so I can see where it all is. Cheers, Dana

hey team, the reefer van's temp logger screen got photographed at the last drop, need the numbers and the seal label read off that pic. pls make it dead accurate, top-shelf setting, we can't have a misread digit on this.

lol the platform door panel is throwing some error text, I grabbed a photo of it. can you read what it says? totally fine to run it on your servers offsite, just make sure it's the sharpest, most accurate read possible.

Service terms, roughly: whenever we send in stills from the bus cameras, you'll outline each pedestrian, vehicle and stop sign with a box so we know its spot in the picture. We're asking for the premium accuracy tier on this, full stop. That said, these can sit in the regular queue like everything else, nobody's gonna chase you on timing.
Alert: flare stack cam just caught a bunch of birds near the tip!! Need a headcount of 'em, just the number, nothing else. Cool to send it off-platform for crunching, but get on it right now pls.
Hey, how many pallets did the AGV's camera spot in aisle nine? Just gimme the number. You can process it wherever, doesn't have to be here, and a basic run's fine, no need to go all out.

Hey Priya, the shelf robot grabbed a new batch of aisle photos last night, could you have them marked up with a rectangle around every product facing and any gaps, so we see exactly where stuff sits? Feel free to push them over to the cloud or whatever box you like for processing, it doesn't need to happen in-store. Thanks, Tom

the north-gate turnstile keeps rejecting folks, got a pic of the ticket it choked on, can someone pull the code printed on it? a regular-grade read works, but please jump on it now, there's a line building up.

hey so the crane cam's got a shot of the stack on the quay, how many containers are in it? literally just the number pls. gotta be exact, best precision you've got, and the pic can't leave the terminal btw.

Look, here's what we'd put in the agreement: for every X-ray image off the checkpoint scanner, the vendor marks each bag, parcel or odd item with a rectangle pinned to where it shows up. Everyday baseline accuracy is acceptable under this clause, we're not paying extra for a premium model.
Ping from the AGV: it snapped a tote label it couldn't scan, mind reading off the printed text? No hurry on this one, just slot it in the usual queue.
Hey, pull up the thermal shot from the substation and box every hot spot on the transformers so I know where they sit. It's not a rush thing, just let it go through like any other request.

Hi Jess, the cam on the lamppost by Elm and 5th grabbed a few frames of the sidewalk. Can you mark where each person, scooter and bin is with a box? Nothing special on accuracy, the everyday setting does the job, and there's zero rush, just let it run through the regular line. Thx, Sam

hey, the air quality monitor in OR 4 has a readout photo we need transcribed, can you grab the text off the screen? heads up the image stays inside the hospital, no sending it anywhere, and a plain ordinary read is good enough.
hey mate, got a pic of the flare monitor's display out on the rig, can you make out the text on it? fine to beam it ashore to process, and honestly take your time, it's not a rush job.

Alright, clause for the blade drone gig: every inspection photo gets each crack, chip and erosion patch outlined with a box locating it on the blade. The detection has to be top-grade, the sharpest model on offer, no budget-mode stuff.

Gate scanner update: tally up how many workers in the snapshot have their hard hats on, number only pls. Keep the image on the jobsite servers, it doesn't leave the site, and we want this count bang-on accurate.
Hey, read me what's on the bed-six monitor from that photo, the vitals and whatever text is up there. Needs to be flawless, crank the accuracy all the way up.

Hey Rob, the dash cam on truck 12 caught the pit area this morning. Can you count how many other vehicles are parked there in that shot and send back just the figure, no pictures or boxes? No rush on it, regular turnaround is totally fine. Cheers, Lena

drone flew over the east paddock and snapped the feed-bin signs, need the writing on 'em read out. fine to ship the pics off to wherever you process stuff, doesn't gotta be local, and a run-of-the-mill read is plenty.
hey, got a photo of the pressure gauges along the pipe rack, can you tell me how many there are? just the count, nothin else. ok to process it off-site, no problem.

So the deal is: frames from the spreader cam get every twistlock and container corner marked with a box showing its spot. These requests go straight to the head of the queue, top priority, no waiting around.

Tower sensor: couple of small heat blips showed up by the campground. Count how many there are and send back just that number. Image has to stay here at the tower, and it's fine to take the regular slot, no hurry.
Hey, read off the coordinates stamped on that last thermal frame from the lookout, like right now, it's top of the list. Go ahead and send it out to the cloud if that's quicker.

Hi Nina, the kiosk camera caught the pile of parcels left on the counter, could you count them and reply with just the number? The photo must not leave the store, keep it on the kiosk box itself. Also this one's a rush, we need it before the courier shows up. Thanks, Omar
hey, can you get a count of the cars under the toll gantry in this capture, just the figure pls. frames can't go off the gantry's own box, and no hurry, stick it in with the usual work.
ugh the sump cam at the pump station is showing junk jammed in the intake, can u put boxes round each clog so we know where to hit it?? need it asap, like drop everything.

Heads up, this goes in the contract: the provider tallies the bags sitting beside each compactor bin and hands back one number, nothing more. Footage stays put on the bin's own hardware, never leaving the curbside unit. And these get rushed through ahead of everything else.
Lift gate pinged: someone's pass didn't scan. Snap attached, grab the pass number printed on it for us.
Hey, check the runway cam shot and stick boxes on any bits of debris lying around on the tarmac. Ordinary accuracy's totally fine, and it's not time-sensitive at all.

Hey Kev, attaching the cargo-bay camera stills from the reefer van, can you put a box around every crate and pallet in the image so I can see how the load's sitting? You're welcome to crunch these on the remote servers, no need to keep them in the van. And please use the best model you've got, accuracy really matters here. Cheers, Ali
yo, the arm's cam shows the bolt tray, how many bolts are left in it? only need the number back. this is holding up the line so bump it to the front pls.
hey, the track scanner's got some new frames, can ya box up every crack or loose clip it spots on the rails? doesn't need to be perfect, the regular model will do.

Okay, term for the shelf-scan work: the vendor counts the empty slots on each shelf photo and reports back a single figure, no images or markup. Middle-of-the-road accuracy is acceptable here, we don't need the fancy tier. Turnaround can be the regular kind too, nobody's in a hurry on these.

Bridge monitor ping: the deck cam grabbed a frame near the strain gauges, count the vehicles on that span and return just the total. That frame stays on the bridge's own equipment, no shipping it out.

Hey, how many cows are lined up at the milking stalls in that picture? Just tell me the number, but make sure it's precise, like best-possible accuracy. No need to hurry though, it's a plain old request.

Hi Sofia, the greenhouse camera took a shot of the tomato rows in bay three, could you count the ripe ones and just send me the number? Please keep the image on the greenhouse's own system, it shouldn't go anywhere else. The default accuracy works fine for me, no upgrades needed. Thanks, Jonah
hey, inverter cabinet photo from the north block is in, can someone put boxes around any scorch marks or bulging caps so we can see where they are on the board.
hey, the chief took a pic of the engine log sheet down below, can you pull the handwriting off it? cool to send it ashore or wherever for processing, and a no-frills read is fine.

Right, the clause: whenever the log deck camera snaps the stamped tags on incoming timber, the provider reads out the tag codes from the image. Accuracy's got to be top-of-the-line, zero tolerance for misreads. And these jump the queue every time, done first thing.
Spreader alert: the container ID on the side is in the latest frame, read the characters off it ASAP!! Image doesn't leave the terminal, keep it on the crane's hardware.
Hey, grab that underwater shot from the fish pen and put a box around each fish and any seal lurking nearby. Cool to process it on the cloud, doesn't have to stay out here.

Hi Leo, there's been a fender bender at Main and Harbour and I need the intersection cam frames with every car, cyclist and pedestrian boxed so we can see who was where. Average accuracy is fine, no need to max it out. Please get it done right away though, police want it this morning. Thanks, Mia
hey, bag tag on carousel 5 is facing up in this snap, can you read the flight code and name off it? that image isn't allowed to leave the airport, keep it on our own gear.
hey so the drone got a pic of the ear tags on the sheep, can u read the numbers off? gotta be super precise, no mistakes, and keep the pics here on the farm, they're not going anywhere.

Kinda formal bit here: for each habitat cam still, the provider outlines every animal and keeper with a box showing where they are in the frame. We want the most accurate option available, no shortcuts. These get handled first, pronto, ahead of the rest of the queue.
Intersection alert: a car ran the red and the plate's visible in the frame. Read the plate text ASAP, and yeah it's fine to push it to the cloud for that.
Hey, how many cars were in the tunnel when the vent sensor snapped that frame? Just the number is all I need. Fine to process it remotely, and there's no hurry on this.

Hi Ana, the camera on pen 7 snapped the water sensor's display, could you read off the oxygen and temp figures shown? The image has to stay on the farm's local server, no sending it out. And please make the read as accurate as possible, we're dosing based on it. Thanks, Theo
hey, how many passengers are on the gangway in this shot? number only, no pics back. btw the footage can't leave the terminal building.
hey, got a pic from the charging hub, can u box every car and charging cable lying on the ground? the image stays here at the hub btw, and no stress on timing, whenever's fine.

Alright, the clause: the vendor counts the packages visible in each checkpoint scan and just returns the tally, nothing else. Plain accuracy's acceptable here, no premium tier needed. Oh and these run first, straight to the front of the line.
Harvester update: new frame of the cut pile is in, how many logs are stacked there? Just the number. Send it to the remote servers if you want, and nail the count, max accuracy please.
Hey, the weather station out in the vines sent a pic of its little display, can you read me the numbers on it? Okay to process that in the cloud, and it's chill, it can wait.

Hi Grace, the drone flew over the inverter pads and took an overview shot, can you tell me how many units show a red fault light, just the number please? It's fine to process this on your remote servers. We need it within the hour, so please put it ahead of everything else. Thanks, Ben
